title: Balancing Utility with Privacy in Generated Synthetic Datasets
summary: A master's thesis codebase comparing four generative models (CTGAN, TVAE, DoppelGANger, Banksformer) for privacy-utility tradeoffs on synthetic financial datasets. The CTGAN and TVAE notebooks instantiate and train sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema, running SDV's tabular synthesizer API as two of the compared generative models.
